payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE (found by bob-cli-ir.2.1 land agent): bob-cli just docs-check fails at lint on bob-cli origin/master 5ef66125 with bob-mac-capture origin/master e7ddfc6 mounted: docs/reference/mac-capture/capture-panel.md 6088, keyboard.md 6060, protocol.md 6014 words (cap 6000 for reference/). Cause: bob-cli-iu.2 commit e7ddfc6 (escape dot-route alias with fast .. and restores). bob_docs.markdown.count_words on bob-mac-capture docs/ at 2a39c2f (parent docs state) gives capture-panel 6000, keyboard 6000, protocol 5995; at e7ddfc6 6088/6060/6014. Every rerun fails identically (fixed count vs fixed cap). Fix in bob-mac-capture docs/{capture-panel,keyboard,protocol}.md (condense or split a coherent section per docs IA rules, without raising the cap), then rerun bob-cli just docs-check. Related history: bob-cli-h9 (earlier protocol.md overage from 8e2ecd7, since trimmed to 5995 before this epic) and bob-cli-bh/bob-cli-il (same budget class, other pages).

LANDING AUDIT at bob-cli 5ef66125 and bob-mac-capture e7ddfc6 (both match freshly fetched origin/master): read this epic, both closed phase beads and every note, approved plan:202611/dot_route_alias.md, epic commits 0b8b913f and e7ddfc6, implementation/tests/fixtures/help/docs. DECISIONS remain after_text, fast 350ms, restore. Rust completion-gated fallback, checkbox/backtick/wikilink guards, precedence of caret/move rules, exact one-byte wire edit, no grammar/version change, and new/old compatibility are implemented. Mac reply-keyed shared gesture arm/probe and restores exist; all 17 new dot hosted tests pass in snapshot CI 42531359678, Lint/Build green. Child iu.2 note #1 (--list) is inert, not a work item; phase checks in iu.1 #1 are historical evidence, not rerun by this audit. No just check/check-full run this turn. INTEGRATION: only non-epic primary commit since first epic commit is Gmail 5ef66125 (task-anchor/recovery changes confined to Gmail and its docs/tests); it has no capture-rewrite caller or shared alias edits. Mac has no later commits. Existing x/s forwarding/type-ahead changes are already in e7ddfc6 base; recheck is.3 drift in the repair. No integration edit needed at this base. Read parent link: no parent_bead. epic-symbols inventory empty; neither main nor linked repo presently requires an iu symbol exemption; no primary just symvision recipe.
FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (all PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries from iu.2): #2 duplicate of bob-cli-it; +1 recorded after independent production validate_mount_targets reproduction with untracked/ignored/unmanifested index. #3 and #5 are one CI report plus duplicate-selection guidance, not two distinct tasks. Independently fetched both jobs: snapshot 42531359678 fails 16 methods across 3 suites (14 separator, 1 model plus-accept, 1 agenda), all present among 19 base failures in 42523594058. Causal eager xx capability probe and its count/readiness effects are owned by active bob-cli-is/is.3, whose notes #2-4 already repair this set; recorded DISCOVERED ISSUE on bob-cli-is. Declined h7 +1 and f3 reopening because these are the newer probe-related regression, not their old alias/picker failures. No new tasks. Carry all outcomes into final close note.
REMAINING EPIC WORK: (1) Controller line 2914 retains a dot arm when characters == dot and timing qualifies even with Command/Control/Option; router correctly refuses that modified fast undo, so the intervening key leaves escape/restore eligible. Require matching modifier/IME/repeat eligibility in preservation. (2) Before Bob replies, the controller only invalidates when equalsGestureArm.key is dot and clearDotGestureArmForInterveningKey itself requires an arm; pendingEqualsFirstKey for dot survives a nonmutating intervening Down/Up/Ctrl-N/P key. A subsequent fast dot can still launch a collapse probe, or the late first reply can freshly arm an already interrupted gesture. Cover pre-reply navigation and reject stale rearming without breaking normal alias rewrite. These are source-level findings, not locally executed AppKit reproductions. (3) ir.2.1 lander note #1 is confirmed with production bob_docs.markdown.count_words on git blobs: Mac docs capture-panel/keyboard/protocol rise from 6000/6000/5995 at 2a39c2f to 6088/6060/6014 at e7ddfc6. Condense without losing contracts or raising caps, then docs-check. This is caused by iu and not a new task/h9 corroboration. Keep epic and plan open; a medium tale will repair only these gaps, verify and perform this epic closeout itself.
